prayers.name: Deadeye
prayers.effect: Increases your ranged attack by 18%, your damage by 18%, and your defence by 5%.
prayers.unlock: Read a Deadeye prayer scroll (untradeable, from Eldric the Ice King at the Royal Titans); it replaces Eagle Eye.

prayers.name: Rigour
prayers.effect: Increases your ranged attack by 20% and damage by 23%, and your defence by 25%.
prayers.unlock: Read a Dexterous prayer scroll (tradeable Chambers of Xeric reward).

prayers.name: Mystic Might
prayers.effect: Increases your magical attack and defence by 15%, also increases your magic strength by 2%.

prayers.name: Mystic Vigour
prayers.effect: Increases your magical attack and defence by 18%, your magic strength by 3% and your defence by 5%.
prayers.unlock: Read a Mystic vigour prayer scroll (untradeable, from Branda the Fire Queen at the Royal Titans); it replaces Mystic Might.

prayers.name: Augury
prayers.effect: Increases your magical attack and defence by 25%, also increases your magic strength by 4% and your defence by 25%.
prayers.unlock: Read an Arcane prayer scroll (tradeable Chambers of Xeric reward).

prayers.name: Chivalry
prayers.effect: Increases your defence by 20%, strength by 18%, and attack by 15%.
prayers.unlock: Complete the King's Ransom quest and then the Knight Waves Training Ground in Camelot.

prayers.name: Piety
prayers.effect: Increases your defence by 25%, strength by 23%, and attack by 20%.
prayers.unlock: Complete the King's Ransom quest and then the Knight Waves Training Ground in Camelot.

prayers.name: Zeal
prayers.effect: Increases your defence by 25%, strength by 28%, and attack by 25%.
prayers.unlock: Bring the Horn of Bran (tradeable reward from The Fractured Archive) to King Arthur in Camelot; it replaces Piety.

prayers.name: Preserve
prayers.unlock: Read a Torn prayer scroll (tradeable Chambers of Xeric reward).
